branchName.instructions: Branch names come from the Kaneo card: VER-<number>, e.g. VER-41 — design work is filed under the Versta App project. Base is main.

commitMessage.instructions: Imperative subject under 72 characters. This repository mirrors accepted state only, so the commit body must cite the verdict that made the change accepted: where it was decided, who decided it, and when. Unaccepted drafts do not belong here.

pullRequest.instructions: Open against main. Body must cite the deciding comment or verdict (issue, author, timestamp) and list which MANIFEST.json entries were added or replaced. Note that tools/audit.mjs needs Playwright, which is not installed in this image, so say whether the audit actually ran.
